What You Bring - Have a proven track record of 4+ years of closing experience in B2B sales, go to market, or a comparable role in a high performing SaaS org, top tier consultancy, or a customer facing role within a relevant industry. - Experience managing end to end deals with multiple stakeholders, navigating procurement or security steps as needed, and consistently hitting targets. - Take clear ownership of quota, outcomes, and customer experience, putting the needs of the business first while maintaining high integrity. - Show perseverance and adaptability, staying focused through ambiguity and learning quickly from what works and what doesn’t. - Are naturally inquisitive and coachable, actively seeking feedback and continuously improving your craft. - Bring strong discovery and storytelling skills, translating complex workflows into simple, value based narratives. - Have enthusiasm for international business development and share our vision of transforming legal work through AI. - Demonstrate a founder like mindset, proactively spotting friction and building scalable systems and playbooks. - Communicate confidently in both English and Italian, with English serving as the primary company language and Italian required for local market engagement and relationship management. Legora is an Equal Opportunity Employer At Legora, we believe great teams are built on diversity of thought and experience. This role exists to build right-sized security programs that scale with Legora, strengthening office security, travel risk, executive protection, and incident readiness without losing the welcoming, open culture we want employees and guests to feel. You'll work across Workplace, People, IT, Security, Legal, Compliance, Comms, business leaders, vendors, and building partners, balancing hands-on operations with repeatable program design. Travel to Legora offices, events, and other locations is expected up to 30% based on operational needs. WHAT YOU'LL DO Corporate Security, Executive Protection & Event Security - Own security operations across Legora's offices, including access control, visitor management, badging, surveillance, guard services, emergency procedures, and facility protection, with baseline standards adapted to each site's local context and risk. - Build and run risk-based executive protection for the CEO and other senior leaders, including protective intelligence, travel risk, ground transportation, advance planning, residential considerations when appropriate, and protection scaled to actual threat and exposure. - Partner with Legal and Compliance to align security and safety programs with applicable requirements and company policies, involving them in relevant decisions, risks and incidents. - Manage security vendors and integrators, including contracts, pricing reviews, staffing models, service quality, and performance, as well as CCTV and alarm maintenance and infrastructure projects. - Own the security budget and forecast, including OPEX and CAPEX, aligning spend to Legora's risk and business priorities. Travel Security & Duty of Care - Build and run Legora's travel risk program, including pre-trip risk guidance, traveler tracking, destination briefings, and added support for higher-risk travel. - Own Legora's duty of care approach, making sure employees know what support exists, how to reach it, and what happens when something goes wrong while they're traveling. - Select and manage travel risk, medical, and security assistance providers, keeping coverage matched to where our people actually

Correctness is non-negotiable, and every bug has a number attached to it. - Design and ship event-driven services end to end: APIs, reconciliation pipelines, queues and more. - Write idempotent, resumable sync logic against third-party SaaS APIs you don’t control, handling partial failures, retries, out-of-order events and concurrency. - Work in Python and Azure, with infrastructure as code in TypeScript (Pulumi). - Own the deployment path: GitHub Actions CI/CD across dev, test and prod with gated environments, plus the observability that goes with it. - Write the tests that make the system safe to change, including unit and contract tests against recorded fixtures. - Work directly with Finance and RevOps to turn billing and revenue requirements into systems they trust, and debug with them when reality disagrees with the data. - Contribute to architecture decisions as the integration surface grows (new systems, entities and flows) without turning the codebase into a pile of special cases. WHO YOU ARE - You have 3+ years of experience building and operating backend systems in production, not just shipping features into one. - You’re strong in Python, and comfortable enough in TypeScript to own infrastructure code (or keen to learn). - You have hands-on experience integrating with REST APIs from SaaS applications, and you’ve moved and transformed data between them. You know what idempotency, retries, eventual consistency and reconciliation mean in practice. - You have experience with a cloud platform, ideally Azure (AWS or GCP translates fine), and with infrastructure as code. - You’re genuinely interested in how a business makes and books money. Experience with financial systems (billing, revenue, ERP) is a plus. - You’re proactive, self-directed and hungry. You take ownership of a system and thrive with a lot of autonomy in a fast-moving, high-growth company. THE ROLE Enterprise buyers lean on analyst research when they shortlist legal AI vendors, so how analysts understand Legora matters. As our Analyst Relations Specialist, you’ll run the operational engine behind that work: briefings, RFIs, evaluation calendars and the insight that comes out of them. You’ll work with Product, GTM, Sales and Marketing so that what analysts say about us turns into sharper positioning, stronger proposals and revenue impact we can measure. Your remit covers firms such as Gartner, IDC, Forrester, TYPi, Legal Tech Hub and G2. ...You'll report to Harry St. John, our VP of Revenue for the US, and be one of the senior voices for Legora with federal buyers, from agency general counsel offices to CIO, CISO and contracting leadership. WHAT YOU’LL DO - Own the federal number: pipeline, forecast, bookings and the multi-year revenue plan. - Decide where we play first. Prioritize agencies based on legal use cases, customer access, procurement paths, security authorization readiness and commercial potential. - Personally lead and close our first federal deals, drawing on your existing agency relationships. - Hire, onboard and coach the first account executives and supporting roles, and set the bar for the team. - Turn early wins into a repeatable motion: how we qualify, which buying path we pursue for each opportunity, how security reviews are sequenced, and how we plan around agency budget cycles. - Coordinate with Security, Compliance, Legal and Finance to understand agency requirements, align deal timelines with authorization and contracting milestones, and surface blockers early. - Partner with Legal Engineering and Solutions Consulting to run evaluations, pilots and proofs of value that agency lawyers actually adopt. - Shape our approach to resellers, integrators and contract-vehicle holders. - Carry the voice of federal customers back to Product and company leadership. - Build Legora's presence in the Washington legal and gov-tech community. - Travel to agency sites, New York City and other Legora locations as the work requires. WHAT YOU BRING - 8+ years in enterprise technology sales, with a substantial portion selling directly to U.S. federal agencies. - A record of exceeding a federal sales quota yourself, alongside experience hiring, coaching and managing federal sellers and building or scaling a federal sales team. - Existing relationships across federal legal, CIO, CISO and procurement offices that can open doors for a new vendor. - Working knowledge of how the federal government buys: FAR basics, schedules and contract vehicles, other-transaction and sole-source routes, and selling through resellers and primes. - Experience selling enterprise software through federal security and auth
